events.summary: An earlier runner ended with shell exit 143 and no Gradle terminal summary; incomplete, not a build pass/fail.

Initial Quickstart packaging needed local credential JSON. A canonical offline synthetic build-only fixture was later used; fixture content is excluded. See the already-published quickstart build-environment receipt.

Europe/Stockholm DST fall-back exposed a 24-hour-versus-previous-calendar-day test assumption. The completed run configured TZ=UTC and declared user.timezone=UTC for Gradle Test tasks; host clock/timezone and application/test source were unchanged.
Early setup attempts failed before valid matrix acceptance: TLS/SSL wrapper access and Android SDK location discovery. A verified toolchain was then installed in a task-local directory.
